name: Tooltip
summary: Shows a brief hint on hover or focus.
description: A lightweight text hint that reveals on hover or keyboard focus of its trigger. It can be placed on any of four sides (top / right / bottom / left) with an arrow pointing back to the trigger, and binds its surface, text, radius, and elevation to the system's semantic tokens. Because it reveals on focus, the trigger must itself be focusable.
whenToUse: Add a short, supplementary hint to a control — what an icon button does
Clarify a label or value without taking up permanent space
whenNotToUse: Essential information a user must not miss — put it inline
Rich or interactive content — use a Popover instead

side.top: Bubble above the trigger — the default.
side.right: Bubble to the right of the trigger.
side.left: Bubble to the left of the trigger.

states.visible: Revealed on hover or focus of the trigger.

dos: Keep the text short — a phrase, not a paragraph
Attach the tooltip to a focusable trigger so keyboard users get it too
Use it for supplementary hints, not essential instructions
donts: Don't hide essential information only inside a tooltip
Don't put links, buttons, or form fields inside — use a Popover
Don't attach a tooltip to a non-focusable element — keyboard users can't reach it

keyboard: Reveals on focus of the trigger and hides on blur
Escape should dismiss it while the trigger stays focused
notes: The bubble carries role="tooltip"; the trigger must be focusable
Reveals on both hover and focus so it isn't pointer-only
Keep the hint supplementary — don't make it the only source of critical info
